key_claim: zT 2.6 at 923 K driven by very high S and ultralow kappa; sigma remains extremely low at room temperature

evidence_sentences.seebeck_coefficient: High-temperature thermoelectric properties of SnSe crystals along the b axis: the Seebeck coefficient is +450 uV/K @ 300 K, while the electrical conductivity remains as low as 0.09 S/cm at room temperature; a zT of 2.6 @ 923 K is obtained.
